features.title: Brilliant tinkerer
features.text: Inventors fight with a signature innovation: custom armor, a construct companion or a one-of-a-kind weapon that they keep improving.

features.title: Overdrive
features.text: Supercharge gear with Crafting and attempt unstable actions such as Explode. A failed flat check blocks further unstable actions until you spend 10 minutes retuning the innovation.

review.notes: Editorial assessment of the class framework and ordinary builds. Rules references support mechanics; scores remain judgments.

ratings.offense: 4 → 3.5–4.5. Overdrive, unstable actions and innovation choices favor different damage patterns.
ratings.defense: 3.5 → 3–4.5. Armor innovations emphasize resilience; construct and weapon builds spend their features elsewhere.
ratings.support: 3 → 2–3.5. Construct positioning and selected gadgets or feats help the party to different degrees.
ratings.utility: 3 → 3–4. Crafting and invention offer practical solutions, especially with relevant feats and downtime.
ratings.difficulty: 3 → 3.5. Manage innovation modifications, Overdrive and unstable recovery.
